This is a great place. Much cheaper than the big hospitals. They speak English fairly well and charge farrang 1baht per mg. Free to citizens. I also get 84 mg of alprazolam for about 450 baht. So I pay 1450 thb every 4 weeks for 1000 mg of methadone and 84 mg of alprazolam. This was over 6k baht at Bangkok Hospital.

The first time I went I had to go to the main location about 30 minute drive north of old city. I had extensive paperwork from my doctor's in the states. You would definitely need that as alprazolam is strictly controlled.  I go every 4 weeks for a refill. During non covid it was every 2 weeks.  Always keep your pink card they give you on your person. Methadone is controlled and your pink card is basically proof of your prescription. It takes 5 to 10 minutes every trip. Very fast and friendly.

This small Clinic called PHA MAI Community Clinic is one of 6 run by Thanyarak Institute & Government Hospital and in charge of Outpatient treatments for dependencies on Alcohol and Heroin* (*methadon treatment) aswell as psychological disbalances.

As a government institution their rates are low and affordable (Check rates at the end of review) compared to specialised private clinics like Bangkok Hospital were one pay around 100$/visit + the cost of medicine and get hardly more then 3days M.prescribed

They also take care of non Thais, meaning any Farang or foreigner is welcome, and this very devoted team in general has a pretty good command of English.
As part of the treatment they deliver 7-15 days Methadon to their patients after a doctor visit and a formal registration.(+ docs *)

They offer the possibility of short stays in hospital and to stay as an inpatient in a post-cure.
A basic understanding in Thai language is required for a post cure.

Offering a fast, discreet, understanding & professional service they are actualy among the few(+ **) to offer such an affordable methadon treatment in Chiang Mai.

This clinic itself is only for outgoing patient and treats also other addictions like Alcohol and other psychological imbalances

Open on
Monday to Saturday : 08.00 to 16.30
Dr Vsits from 09h00 to 11h00 only Monday-Tuesday
Doctor Visit: 200bth
Methadon: 1bath/1cc
(This rate for foreigners only/ Thai people don't pay)

+*   Certificat from former treating Doctor is a plus .
+** A similar clinic in CMai is 'PANU MD.Clinic' check on Google Map for full review!

There are 6 other Thayanrak Methadon Clinics in Thailand: Bangkok, MaeHongSon, Puket, Chiang Mai and 2 other major cities.
